_help: A-33 the Starlight Tavern of Oakhaven (scripts/Tavern.cs). x, z = the middle of the building in the world (west of the square, between the two western roads), rot = quarter turns of the blueprint (1 = the door faces east, towards the square). The tavern becomes the town's inn (villagers whose schedule says 'inn' eat and spend their evenings there). staff = ids of data/npcs.json (the elf maids). By day (their work hours) they walk between the tables and say a 'serveLines' line; during show.from .. show.to (hours) they stand on the stage and dance in step (side steps, a spin every spinEvery seconds, a cheer every cheerEvery), and take turns to sing a song every songEvery seconds: its lines as speech bubbles lineGap seconds apart, notes floating up, and its 'tune' (steps of the instrument's scale) played on 'instrument' (data/instruments.json). After a song the patrons clap and call a 'cheers' line. Talking to a maid: the menu (dishes of data/cooking.json by id and their price; they go into the pack as food), a tip (gold for standing with her and the town, once every tip.every seconds of play) and a song request (request.gold, show hours only).
name: The Starlight Tavern
serveLines: One honey cake, coming right up!
The stage lights up at dusk. Do stay!
thanks: Thank you so much! You are too kind.
Oh! For me? I will sing my best tonight.

lines: Leave your sword beside the door,
tonight the realm needs you no more!
One moon of silver, one of shade,
they dance above the forest glade.
Step to the light, turn to the dark,
and follow, follow the firefly's spark!
Sugar and starlight, butter and bloom,
the sweetest of cakes in the cosiest room.
One bite for courage, two bites for cheer,
three bites and, traveller, you'll always come here!
